text: Of David. 1 Judge me, O YHWH! For I have walked in my integrity, and I have trusted in YHWH without slipping.
Examine me, O YHWH, and test me; refine my kidneys and my heart.
For Your loving devotion [is] before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.
I do not sit with men of vanity, and with dissemblers I will not go in.
I hate the assembly of evildoers, and with the wicked I do not sit.
I wash my hands in innocence, and I go about Your altar, O YHWH,
to sound with a voice of thanksgiving, and to recount all Your wonders.
O YHWH, I love the habitation of Your house, and the place of the dwelling of Your glory.
Do not gather my soul with sinners, and my life with men of blood,
in whose hands [is] a scheme, and [whose] right hand is filled [with] a bribe.
And I, in my integrity, walk; redeem me and be merciful to me.
My foot stands on level ground; in the assemblies I will bless YHWH.
